_doc.about: beat: cut on the beat with punch-ins, whips, one three-panel split and Lalezar slams (the «قوم يا مصري» look, 2026-11-08). Use it only when the owner asks for energy («حماسي»).
_doc.beat: the song's beat grid in film time: period (s per beat) and phase (s of the first beat); or {"bpm": 107.7, "phase": 0.35}; or "auto" (measured with librosa: python scripts/dragon.py beats song.wav first if unsure)
_doc.shots[].beats: how many beats the shot lasts; shots follow each other on the grid from 0 s
_doc.shots[].tri: three shots shown as vertical panels, one arriving per beat, the middle one opening to full frame (beats = length of the split)
_doc.shots[].rest: true: runs from the end of the beat shots to the end of the film (the end card sits on it)
_doc.shots[].broll: true for aerials / library shots: no whip into or out of them
_doc.slams: big Lalezar words: {text, beats: [first, last]} or {text, start, end}; '…' is replaced with '،' (Lalezar has no '…' glyph)
_doc.punch / whip / bar: punch-in strength (0.12), whip on every second cut (true), slam underline colour (#c8102e; null hides it)
_doc.end: at defaults to the start of the rest shot; title in white Lalezar, sub in gold Tajawal; credit 1.6 s later
